calibration.why: The cross_document_reconciliation verdict says the release and the 10-K 'agree on every figure both carry', yet its own anomaly cross_document_reconciliation_litigation_reversal_amounts reports a release-versus-tag difference. Most financial anomalies sit under sections whose readings were dropped.
